narrative.details:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
narrative.offerRewardText: And so it continues, Father Cenarius.<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>Greetings again, Qiy. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 20, 3,650 XP in all.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

quests.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
To Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
